transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bothering you or what brings you in today?

I guess what’s been bothering me is… I just don’t have the push I used to. I used to go to choir, do my quilting, visit people, but lately most days I just sit at home with the TV on low. I know folks are expecting me sometimes, but I still don’t get myself up to go.
Would you say you feel depressed most of the day?
I don’t know if I’d call it depressed most of the day. I feel kind of low sometimes, I guess, but mostly I just don’t have much get-up-and-go.
Have you found that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like choir or quilting?

Yes… I think so. I used to like choir and quilting, and seeing folks, but now I just don’t feel the push to go do it. Most days I end up sitting at home with the TV on low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even when you haven’t done much?

Yes, I guess I have. Even when I haven’t done much, I just don’t feel like I’ve got the energy or the push to get up and go to choir or work on my quilting. I mostly just sit with the TV on low, even when I know folks are expecting me.
How long have you been feeling this way, with low energy and not enjoying your usual activities?
It’s been going on a good while now. I’d say it started building after I retired from the school office… a little over two years ago.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in anything at all anymore, or have completely lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

I wouldn’t say nothing at all, but… mostly I just don’t have the push like I used to. Choir, quilting, going to see folks—those used to matter more to me. Now a lot of days I just stay home with the TV on low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Would you say you feel sad or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t know that I’d call it sad most of the day. I feel kind of down sometimes, but mostly I just feel worn out and not very motivated. It’s hard for me to say it’s nearly every day depressed.
Have you found that nothing really brings you pleasure anymore—even things you used to enjoy, like seeing friends or working on quilts?

It’s not that nothing brings me any pleasure at all. It’s more that I just don’t have the push I used to. Choir, quilting, going to visit folks… I know I used to do those things, and people expect me sometimes, but most days I just end up sitting at home with the TV on low.
Would you say that you take less pleasure in most things you do these days, even things you used to enjoy?

Yes… I think I do take less pleasure in most things now. I used to like choir and quilting and visiting folks, but I just don’t have the push for it like I did. Most days I just stay home with the TV on low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Would you say that you’ve completely lost interest in all activities—like choir, quilting, or visiting friends—that you used to enjoy?

I wouldn’t say completely lost interest in all of it. It’s more that I just don’t have the push I used to. Choir, quilting, visiting folks… I think about going, and I know people might be expecting me, but most days I just end up sitting at home with the TV on low.
Would you say that you've completely stopped enjoying or caring about things you used to like, such as choir, quilting, or seeing friends?

Not completely, no. I still care some, I guess. But what brings me in is I just don’t have the push like I used to for choir, or quilting, or going to see folks. Most days I just end up at home with the TV on low, even when I know people are expecting me.
Have you found that you take absolutely no pleasure or interest in anything at all anymore, even in things you used to really enjoy?

No, I wouldn’t say absolutely none at all. It’s more like… I just don’t have the push I used to. Choir, quilting, visiting folks—I know I used to do those things, and I know people expect me sometimes, but most days I just sit at home with the TV on low.
